subject: Laptop battery issue - Order #4490237
body:
Hello Nexora Support,

I purchased a Nexora Book 14 on 11 Aug 2026 (order #4490237, ₹47,990) and I am facing a serious battery problem. The battery was lasting about 7 hours initially, but for the past three weeks it drains from 100% to 20% in barely 90 minutes while I am only browsing or attending video calls. The charge indicator also jumps suddenly, for example from 38% to 12%, and twice the laptop shut down without any warning even though it showed more than 30%.

I have tried the battery calibration steps and the power settings recommended on your website, and I also ran the built-in battery report. The report shows the full-charge capacity has dropped to nearly 54% of the design capacity in just over two months, which does not look normal for a new laptop. I have attached the battery report and the invoice.

I work from my home in HSR Layout and travel to the office twice a week, so I really depend on the battery. Could you please advise whether the battery can be replaced under warranty, and whether I can submit the laptop at your Bengaluru service centre or arrange a pickup? I would like to know how many days the repair is likely to take, as I would need a loan laptop or at least a clear timeline.

Thank you for your help.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
+91 98450 61329

Hello,

I am writing again about my washing machine. As you can see from the earlier mail below, a technician visited on 9 Oct and said the drain pump was replaced. I am not asking for compensation, but I would really like this repaired properly by someone senior who understands the machine. If the pump itself is faulty again, please replace it or the unit. Kindly confirm a technician and a date. I am free on Saturday 24 Oct after 10 AM at Kothrud, Pune.
